eq-ch02-svp-cc: Clausius-Clapeyron: the Clapeyron slope of the coexistence curve for an ideal vapor over a condensate of negligible volume.
eq-ch02-svp-kirchhoff: Kirchhoff's law: with constant heat capacities the latent heat is linear in $T$, with intercept $L_0$ at $T = 0$.
eq-ch02-svp-beta-gamma: The fit coefficients: $\beta = L_0/(\mathcal R T_3)$ and $\gamma = \Delta c/\mathcal R$.
eq-ch02-svp-ideal: Clausius-Clapeyron integrated from $(T_3, p_3)$ with the linear latent heat, written in $t = T/T_3$.
eq-ch02-svp-latent: The latent heat a fit implies at any temperature, $\mathcal R(\beta T_3 - \gamma T)$.
eq-ch02-svp-ideal-ddT: The temperature derivative of the ideal form; $\mathcal R T^2$ times it returns the latent heat.
eq-ch02-svp-antoine: The Antoine equation, $\log_{10}$ of the pressure in bar, converted to $\ln$ of the pressure in Pa.
